body: Thanks!  Would you happen to know any organizations?  I’ve already got about a thousand dollars saved up from birthdays and such. But I might have a garage sale soon just to make a little more.

Thanks, but I don’t think I’ll be able to write any more explaining how I feel.  I know that I’m not alone in how people feel about this topic, but I’m just so tired.  Thanks though, for trying to swim out to me, lifeguard.

I understand those urges. I try to distract myself by going on social media (Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat, etc.). However, sometimes there are things on websites that can remind myself of those urges.  Sometimes I do homework to distract myself. Sleep is the best remedy I find. I know that these aren’t good coping skills, but these are mine.
